label: early copy phase, d/s/w about to be output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original or delimiter steps, mostly at recall_idx 1-4 (96% of mass at recall_idx<=4). It is strongly selective for upcoming outputs d, s, w (out_tok / next_out lift ~6-7x): activation is largest one or two steps before d/s/w is emitted, and the top examples are short sequences dense in w/s/d (e.g. j s w w s l <DEL> peaks on the first copy step). Stronger for short L (4-6) and sequences with few digits. The predicate (early copy step with d/s/w within the next three outputs) captures ~84% of mass but precision is only ~0.36, because many such steps stay silent; there is a long tail of weak activations at early copy steps with no d/s/w nearby.
